title: OPF v1 manifest
description: JSON Schema for the Open Pack Format (OPF) v1 manifest.json. Unknown top-level fields are preserved and ignored (layering extension path); they must not cause validation errors.

pack_format.description: OPF spec version this manifest conforms to. For OPF v1 this is 1. Validators select the schema by reading pack_format first.

name.description: Lowercase [a-z0-9._-], 1-64 characters, no leading or trailing separator, and never '.' or '..'. Used for identity and state keys.

version.description: Semver. Compared against the installed .opf-lock version to decide update versus fresh install.

vendor.description: The publishing namespace, declared by the author. A namespace, not verified.

images.description: First is the card thumbnail; the rest populate the detail carousel. Optional and non-load-bearing.

skills.description: Skill identifiers, one per skills/<name>/ subfolder. Must match the agentskills.io skill-id grammar and the SKILL.md name field.

tools.description: Tool identifiers, one per tools/<name>/ subfolder.

routines.description: Routine identifiers, one per routines/<name>/ subfolder.

agents.description: Agent identifiers, one per agent item.

contents.description: Declared item kinds and their identifiers, for example { "skills": ["report-format"], "routines": ["pack-sync"] }. Keys are plural, matching the directory names. The validator checks contents against the actual folders as a warning, not an error.

version.description: Semver range for the dependency, in node-semver range syntax (https://github.com/npm/node-semver#ranges), e.g. '^1.2.3', '~1.2.3', '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0'. No leading 'v'.

url.description: Source repository URL where the dependency pack can be fetched if not already installed. A relative path, file:// URL, or private-registry URL (SSH, CI-job-token-gated) is acceptable.

ref.description: Optional. The git ref a rolling consumer tracks (spec Section 9.2), e.g. 'main'. Informational; does not affect range-based resolution.

items.description: Dependencies are other packs, declared by vendor, name, a version range, and a source url. Unknown fields are preserved per the spec's layering rule.

dependencies.description: Dependencies are other packs, declared by vendor, name, a version range, and a source url.

name.description: Environment variable name exposed to scripts, routines, and tools at run time. Must not shadow PACK_* variables.

description.description: Human-readable explanation shown when prompting the user.

required.description: Whether the value is mandatory. Default false.

items.description: Required/optional configuration entries. Unknown fields are preserved per the spec's layering rule.

exclude.description: Path patterns excluded from content scanning. Glob-style matches and exact paths are supported. Exclusions never apply to executable file types; excluded files are still checksummed.

scan.description: Scan configuration. Unknown fields are preserved per the spec's layering rule.

data_dir.description: Preferred name for the runtime data directory: a single path segment, no '/' separators, and never '.' or '..'. Optional hint.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value object for org-specific annotations. Non-load-bearing; never validated beyond being an object if present.
